slides.title: UPDATE = [[data badlo]]
slides.note: Naya data daalna = INSERT. **Purana badalna** = UPDATE

slides.title: Aarav ka [[hike]] 🎉
Sirf [[ek row]] badli
slides.note: WHERE id = 1 ne **sirf Aarav** ko pakda. Baaki safe ✅

slides.title: Ek saath [[multiple]]
slides.code:
UPDATE employees
SET salary = salary * 1.10,
    city = 'Pune'
WHERE dept = 'IT';
slides.note: Comma se **kai columns**, aur purani value pe **maths** bhi 🔥

slides.title: Safe [[UPDATE]] habit
points: Pehle **SELECT** chalao, same WHERE ke saath
slides.note: MySQL Workbench ka **safe update mode** bina key-WHERE ke UPDATE rok deta hai
